description: This Java source file implements the class DistributedSubImpl, which is a package-private implementation of the DistributedSub interface. The class manages subscription operations with a pub/sub system, including subscribe, unsubscribe, declare acknowledgement labels, and remove subscriber, utilizing Akka actors and clustering features.

classes.name: DistributedSubImpl
classes.description: Final class implementing the DistributedSub interface, managing pub/sub subscription lifecycle including acknowledgments, using Akka actors.

methods.name: subscribeWithFilterAndAck
methods.description: Subscribes to topics with a filter predicate and acknowledgment handling, returning a CompletionStage for the subscription acknowledgement.

methods.name: subscribeWithAck
methods.description: Subscribes to topics with acknowledgment, returning a CompletionStage for the subscription acknowledgement.

methods.name: unsubscribeWithAck
methods.description: Unsubscribes from topics with acknowledgment, returning a CompletionStage for the unsubscription acknowledgement.

methods.name: askSubSupervisor
methods.description: Helper method to send a request to the subSupervisor actor and process the response.

methods.name: subscribeWithoutAck
methods.description: Subscribes to topics without acknowledgment, informing the subSupervisor actor directly.

methods.name: unsubscribeWithoutAck
methods.description: Unsubscribes from topics without acknowledgment, informing the subSupervisor actor directly.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from the pub/sub system.

methods.name: declareAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Declares acknowledgment labels for a subscriber, returning a CompletionStage for the operation result.

methods.name: removeAcknowledgementLabelDeclaration
methods.description: Removes the acknowledgment label declaration for a subscriber.

methods.name: processAskResponse
methods.description: Processes responses from ask() calls, returning appropriate CompletionStage based on response type.
